verdict.rationale: iTerm2 has its own automation features that run without user action. Regex triggers automatically run commands, respond to prompts, send notifications or invoke Python scripts when matching output appears. An AutoLaunch script runs on startup, and the Python API supports building further automations. However, these are event-driven terminal hooks, not agent-style autonomous background jobs. missing for 10: recurring/scheduled background execution, AI-agent-driven autonomous tasks, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended automation workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Regex patterns that fire actions when matched: highlight text, run commands, send notifications, open password manager, set marks, or invoke Python scripts.
You can use it to highlight words, automatically respond to prompts, notify you when something important happens, and more.
If it is found, the "AutoLaunch.scpt" script is launched and executed.
Python Scripting API - Full automation and customization via Python.
